title: The digital capacity conjecture for the analogue communication network
statement: Let the communication network be the one depicted in figure labelled `analogue`, and let its digital capacity denote the largest rate achievable using digital communication. **Digital capacity conjecture.** The digital capacity of this network is strictly less than $1$. The paper presents this as an open conjecture motivated by the gap between the known lower and upper bounds for the two communication models.
source_name: Søren Riis, “Network Communication with operators in Dedekind Finite and Stably Finite Rings”, arXiv:1507.01249 (2015).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1507.01249
